description: A corpus-local stand-in for a VER Registry snapshot, used only by --registry for the VER1205 and VER1206 fixtures. It is NOT the governed snapshot under standards/registry/ and carries no authority whatsoever: nothing may cite it as evidence that any token is registered. It exists so the corpus's expected codes never depend on a governed artifact that changes on its own schedule.

entries.definition: A visible or invisible watermark was applied to the Asset. Illustrative: this token is active in THIS corpus-local snapshot and nowhere else.
